```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(enrichR)

result_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm"
```

```{r}
load(file.path(result_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_annotated.RData") )
```

# Enrichment of DM genes in functional / genomic categories

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and raw pvalue < 0.001 as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp = all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNonIM_592_594_avg"]]
hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))


```


We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 

## Hypermethylated genes

```{r}
 zz = enrichr(hyper_genes_592_594, databases = c("ChEA_2016", "ARCHS4_TFs_Coexp", "ARCHS4_Kinases_Coexp", "Drug_Perturbations_from_GEO_up", "Drug_Perturbations_from_GEO_down", "ENCODE_and_ChEA_Consensus_TFs_from_ChIP-X",  "Genome_Browser_PWMs", "RNAseq_Automatic_GEO_Signatures_Human_Up", "RNAseq_Automatic_GEO_Signatures_Human_Down"   ))

zz_df = do.call(rbind, mapply(function(x,n) {x$db=n; return(x)}, zz, names(zz), SIMPLIFY = F))
zz_df$geneset_size = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(strsplit(zz_df$Overlap, "\\/"), `[`, 2)))
zz_df$overlap_size = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(strsplit(zz_df$Overlap, "\\/"), `[`, 1)))
zz_df$overlap_proportion = zz_df$overlap_size/zz_df$geneset_size
zz_df = subset(zz_df, geneset_size >= 20)
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
for (n in unique(zz_df$db)) {
  tmp = subset(zz_df, db==n)
  tmp = tmp[order(tmp$Adjusted.P.value),]
  with(head(tmp, 20), dotchart(-log10(Adjusted.P.value), labels = Term, pt.cex = overlap_proportion*100, pch=20, main = n, xlab="-log10(adj. p-value)"))
}
```


## Hypomethylated genes

```{r}
 zz = enrichr(hypo_genes_592_594, databases = c("ChEA_2016", "ARCHS4_TFs_Coexp", "ARCHS4_Kinases_Coexp", "Drug_Perturbations_from_GEO_up", "Drug_Perturbations_from_GEO_down", "ENCODE_and_ChEA_Consensus_TFs_from_ChIP-X",  "Genome_Browser_PWMs", "RNAseq_Automatic_GEO_Signatures_Human_Up", "RNAseq_Automatic_GEO_Signatures_Human_Down"   ))

zz_df = do.call(rbind, mapply(function(x,n) {x$db=n; return(x)}, zz, names(zz), SIMPLIFY = F))
zz_df$geneset_size = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(strsplit(zz_df$Overlap, "\\/"), `[`, 2)))
zz_df$overlap_size = as.numeric(unlist(sapply(strsplit(zz_df$Overlap, "\\/"), `[`, 1)))
zz_df$overlap_proportion = zz_df$overlap_size/zz_df$geneset_size
zz_df = subset(zz_df, geneset_size >= 20)
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
for (n in unique(zz_df$db)) {
  tmp = subset(zz_df, db==n)
  tmp = tmp[order(tmp$Adjusted.P.value),]
  with(head(tmp, 20), dotchart(-log10(Adjusted.P.value), labels = Term, pt.cex = overlap_proportion*100, pch=20, main = n, xlab="-log10(adj. p-value)"))
}
```
